key_facts: Kimi Antonelli, driving car 12 for Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team, left the track at Turn 6 on Lap 44 of the 2026 British Grand Prix without a justifiable reason.
This was Antonelli's fourth track limits infringement (a breach of the regulation that requires drivers to keep their car within the boundaries of the track) during the race.
Although Antonelli's car was experiencing a mechanical issue, the Stewards found this did not amount to a justifiable reason for leaving the track.
The Stewards imposed a 5 second time penalty, which is the standard penalty for a fourth track limits infringement during a race.
plain_explanation:
Kimi Antonelli, driving the number 12 Mercedes car, left the track at Turn 6 on Lap 44 of the 2026 British Grand Prix without a justifiable reason. This was his fourth track limits infringement of the race.

The Stewards reviewed positioning and marshalling system data, video evidence, and in-car video to reach their decision. Although the car was experiencing a mechanical issue, the Stewards found that this did not provide a justifiable reason for leaving the track. Under the Penalty Guidelines, the standard penalty for a fourth track limits infringement during the race is a 5 second time penalty. The Stewards therefore imposed this standard penalty.
